blocks.arabic_text: رِعَاءَ الشَّاءِ يَتَطَاوَلُونَ فِي الْبُنْيَانِ قَالَ: ثُمَّ إِنْطَلَقَ فَلَبِثْتُ مَلِيّاً ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي: يَا عُمَرُ! أَتَدْرِي مَنِ السَّائِلُ؟ قُلْتُ اَللهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ قَالَ: فَإِنَّهُ جِبْرِيلُ أَتَاكُمْ يُعَلِّمُكُمْ دِينَكُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب بيان الايمان والاسلام... رقم:٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Umar ibn Khattab (RA) says, “While we were sitting in the gathering of Rasulullah ﷺ, a man came whose clothes were extremely white and whose hair was extremely black. There was no sign on him that he was a traveller (and none of us knew him, so as to say that he was a resident of Madinah). He sat very close, joining his knees to the knees of the Prophet ﷺ, and placing both his hands on his thighs, he said, “O Muhammad ﷺ! What is Islam?” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Islam is that you bear witness (with heart and tongue) that there is none worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad ﷺ is the Messenger of Allah, that you establish Salah, give Zakat, fast in Ramadan, and perform Hajj if you have the ability to perform Hajj.” Hearing this, he said, “You have spoken the truth.” Hazrat Umar (RA) says, 'He asks the question (like one who does not know), and on hearing the answer he confirms the answer like one who knows; this action of his left us in amazement.' Then he asked, “What is Iman?' Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Iman is to affirm with the heart Allah, His angels, His Books, His Messengers and the Day of Final Judgement, and to believe that good and evil (happen) according to destiny.” To this too the man said, “You have spoken the truth.'
